data_source_description: Data from the Food Research Laboratory (FRL) of the Centre for Food Safety (CFS), Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
local_evidence_file: 来源证据/Nutrient_profiles_FRL.xlsx (Eng表第313行 / 数据记录第310条)

analytical_and_reporting_notes.protein_method: Total nitrogen determined by Kjeldahl method, multiplied by factor 6.25
analytical_and_reporting_notes.total_fat_method: Gravimetric method: acid hydrolysis followed by ether and petroleum ether extraction
analytical_and_reporting_notes.available_carbohydrate_method: Calculated by difference: 100g minus total grams of water, protein, fat, ash and dietary fibre

atwater_comparison.handling_rule: CFS官方原表能量(100 kcal)与4/9/4折算值(105.34 kcal)差异如实保留为公布数据固有差异；官方文档未披露成因，不推测成因（不武断归因于纤维扣除或kJ整百取整）。

analytical_and_reporting_notes.fat_attribution_rule: CFS化验测定样品每100g含总脂肪1.1g（单份200g基线含总脂肪2.2g）。该数值为送检熟制净肠粉样品的实测总脂肪，不据此断言全部来自防粘油，亦不断言食堂现场未另行刷油，仅作为中心估算基线如实采纳。
